title: Corner C5 - Weekly Recap Animation Visual Spec
summary: Visual spec for the Monday morning weekly recap animation. 30-60 second choreographed sequence showing agent accomplishments, stats, streaks, and upcoming priorities. The 'was this worth it?' answer, delivered visually.
content:
Corner C5: Weekly Recap Animation Visual Spec

Steffen | 2026-03-16 For: Bobby (implementation) | Steve (product owner) Trigger: First login of the week (Monday 6 AM - Tuesday 6 AM, client timezone) Duration: 30-60 seconds (content-driven, more agents = longer recap) Technology: Framer Motion sequences + existing isometric renderer

Design Philosophy

Monday morning. Client opens Corner. Instead of a static dashboard, they see their week unfold. Agents walk, numbers roll, accomplishments highlight. It's the weekly standup meeting, automated and visual. The client should finish the recap thinking "yeah, this was worth $3,000 this month."

Not a cinematic intro. Not a loading screen. A concise, data-driven animation that respects the client's time but delivers a genuine "your team showed up" moment.

Color System

Uses the existing Megaboard dark theme plus some recap-specific additions:

Token Value Usage
bg-recap #050810 Deepest background, theatrical
bg-card #0C1120 Stat cards during roll-up
text-hero #FDF6EC Big numbers, headlines
text-body #F0ECE6 Description text
text-muted #6B7280 Labels, timestamps
accent-gold #C9A84C XP highlights, celebration
accent-primary #E85D26 Agent highlights, CTA
stat-green #22C55E Positive metrics
stat-yellow #F59E0B Neutral metrics

Sequence Breakdown

Pre-Load (Before Animation Starts)

While the recap data loads (1-2 seconds):

  • Screen shows bg-recap with "CORNER." wordmark, centered, pulsing gently (opacity 0.3 to 0.5, 1.5s)
  • No loading spinner. The dimmed wordmark IS the loading state.

Beat 1: Title Card (0-2.5s)

Fade in (0-1.0s):

  • Background: bg-recap
  • Title: "WEEK IN REVIEW"
    • Font: Syne 800, 16px, accent-gold, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.15em
    • Fade in + tracking animation: letter-spacing starts at 0.3em, animates to 0.15em (300ms ease-out)
    • Opacity: 0 > 1 (400ms)

Date range (0.5-1.2s):

  • "March 10 - 16, 2026"
  • Font: Space Grotesk 400, 14px, text-muted
  • Fade in from below: translateY(10px) > 0, opacity 0 > 1 (300ms, 500ms delay)

Hold (1.2-2.0s):

  • Static hold. Let the title register.

Transition out (2.0-2.5s):

  • Title and date fade up and out: translateY(0) > translateY(-20px), opacity 1 > 0 (300ms ease-in)

Beat 2: The Office Awakens (2.5-5.0s)

The isometric office fades in from the existing game view.

Fade in (2.5-3.5s):

  • Full isometric office appears, zoomed to Overview level (0.7 scale)
  • Fade in: opacity 0 > 1 (600ms ease-out)
  • All rooms visible, but agents are NOT at their desks yet
  • Rooms are dimmed (brightness 0.6)
  • Ambient: very subtle particle layer (3-4 slow-moving dots, like dust motes in morning light)

Agents appear (3.5-5.0s):

  • Agents pop in at their desks one by one, 150ms stagger between each
  • Pop animation: scale 0 > 1.1 > 1.0 (spring, 250ms per agent)
  • Rooms brighten as their agent appears (brightness 0.6 > 1.0, 200ms)
  • Order: by XP earned this week (highest first, star performers appear first)

Beat 3: Agent Highlights (5.0-20.0s, variable)

For each agent that completed tasks this week (max 5 agents shown, sorted by impact):

Each agent highlight takes 2.5-3.0 seconds:

Camera pan (0-0.5s):

  • Camera smoothly pans to the agent's room (same camera system as game mode)
  • Zoom to Neighborhood level (1.6 scale)
  • Pan: 500ms ease-in-out

Agent spotlight (0.5-1.2s):

  • Agent sprite does their celebration animation (if available) or a small bounce
  • Room border glows briefly in agent color (box-shadow: 0 0 16px agentColor at 20%, 400ms)
  • Agent's level badge appears above their sprite in the isometric view (same badge from XP spec)

Speech bubble (0.8-2.5s):

  • Typewriter-style speech bubble appears above the agent
  • Container: bg-white (#FFFFFF), border-radius 8px, padding 8px 12px
  • Max-width: 220px
  • Triangle pointer at bottom pointing to agent
  • Shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)

Speech bubble content:

  • Bold stat: "[N] tasks completed" in Space Grotesk 700, 14px, text-hero (#111)
  • Top accomplishment: "Best: [task name]" in Space Grotesk 400, 11px, #666
  • Typewriter speed: 30ms per character (fast, not annoying)
  • Full text visible for 800ms after typing completes

Transition to next agent (2.5-3.0s):

  • Speech bubble fades out (opacity 1 > 0, 200ms)
  • Camera begins panning to next agent

If agent had 0 completions: Skip them. Only show agents with results.

If only 1-2 agents had completions: That's fine. Shorter recap. Quality over quantity.

Beat 4: Stats Roll-Up (20.0-32.0s)

Camera zooms back to Overview. The isometric office dims to 40% brightness. Stats overlay appears.

Transition (20.0-21.0s):

  • Camera smoothly zooms out to Overview (700ms ease-in-out)
  • Office dims: brightness filter 1.0 > 0.4 (400ms)
  • Dark overlay: rgba(5, 8, 16, 0.6) fades in on top

Stats Grid (21.0-30.0s):

6 stat cards appear in a 3x2 grid (2x3 on mobile), centered on screen.

Stagger: 200ms between each card appearing.

Card Animation: scale 0.8 > 1.0, opacity 0 > 1, translateY(20px) > 0 (300ms spring per card)

Card Design:

  • Width: 200px (desktop) / 140px (mobile)
  • Height: 100px
  • Background: bg-card (#0C1120)
  • Border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)
  • Border-radius: 10px
  • Padding: 16px
  • Display: flex, flex-direction: column, justify-content: center, align-items: center

Card Content:

  • Stat number: Syne 800, 28px, text-hero
  • Number uses countUp animation (counts from 0 to actual value, 600ms, ease-out)
  • Stat label: JetBrains Mono 500, 9px, text-muted, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.12em
  • Below label (optional): comparison to last week: "+12%" in stat-green or "-5%" in stat-yellow

The 6 Stats:

# Stat Label Example
1 Tasks completed TASKS COMPLETED 23
2 Messages exchanged MESSAGES 147
3 Most active agent MVP AGENT Bobby
4 Hours saved (estimated) HOURS SAVED 18.5
5 XP earned XP EARNED 340
6 Business level LEVEL 5

Stat #3 (MVP Agent) special treatment:

  • Instead of a number, show the agent's SpriteAvatar (32px) + name
  • Name in Space Grotesk 700, 16px, agent color
  • Small crown icon (Lucide Crown, 14px, accent-gold) above avatar

Stat #6 (Level) special treatment:

  • Show the tier-based level badge (large version, 16px number)
  • XP progress bar below (small, 4px height)
  • If leveled up this week: brief gold pulse on the badge (scale 1.0 > 1.1 > 1.0, 300ms)

Stats hold (30.0-32.0s):

  • All 6 cards visible. Let the numbers register.

Stats exit (32.0-33.0s):

  • All cards fade out simultaneously: opacity 1 > 0, translateY(0) > translateY(-10px), 300ms ease-in

Beat 5: Streak Status (33.0-37.0s)

If the client has an active streak:

Flame animation (33.0-34.5s):

  • Large flame icon (48px) appears center screen
  • Grows from 0 to 48px (spring, 400ms)
  • Flame animation running (flicker + sway from XP spec)

Streak text (34.0-36.0s):

  • Below flame: "[N]-DAY STREAK"
  • Font: Syne 800, 24px, text-hero
  • Fade in from below: 300ms

Multiplier (34.5-36.0s):

  • Below streak text: "[X]x MULTIPLIER ACTIVE"
  • Font: JetBrains Mono 600, 12px, accent-gold
  • Fade in: 200ms delay after streak text

Hold (36.0-37.0s):

  • Static. Let the streak number hit.

If no active streak: Skip this beat entirely. No empty state. No "0-day streak." Just move on.

Transition (37.0-37.5s):

  • Flame and text fade out: opacity 1 > 0, 300ms

Beat 6: This Week's Priorities (37.5-44.0s)

Office brightens back. Show what's coming.

Transition (37.5-38.5s):

  • Overlay fades out: rgba(5,8,16,0.6) > transparent (400ms)
  • Office brightens: brightness 0.4 > 1.0 (400ms)

Priority list (38.5-43.0s):

  • Appears as a floating panel, center-right of the screen (doesn't block the office view entirely)
  • Panel design: same as bg-card, border-radius 12px, padding 20px

Header:

  • "THIS WEEK" in Syne 800, 14px, accent-gold, uppercase
  • Margin-bottom: 16px

Priority items (top 3 from task list):

  • Each item staggers in: 200ms delay between items
  • Item animation: translateX(20px) > 0, opacity 0 > 1, 250ms ease-out

Item design:

  • Display: flex, gap: 10px
  • SpriteAvatar: 24px (assigned agent)
  • Task text: Space Grotesk 400, 13px, text-body
  • Max 1 line, ellipsis
  • Agent name below: JetBrains Mono 400, 9px, agent color, uppercase
  • Margin-bottom: 12px between items

If no upcoming tasks: Show "Your slate is clean. Ready for whatever's next." in text-muted, italic.

Hold (43.0-44.0s):

  • Panel holds. Last visual before the CTA.

Beat 7: Closing CTA (44.0-48.0s)

Priority panel fades out (44.0-44.5s):

  • Opacity 1 > 0, translateX(0) > translateX(20px), 300ms

Closing message (44.5-46.5s):

  • Centered on screen, over the brightened office
  • "Your team is ready. Let's go."
  • Font: Syne 800, 28px (desktop) / 22px (mobile), text-hero
  • Fade in from below: translateY(20px) > 0, opacity 0 > 1, 400ms ease-out
  • Orange underline animates under "Let's go.": width 0 > 100%, 300ms ease-out, 200ms delay
  • Underline: 3px solid accent-primary

Hold (46.5-47.5s):

  • Message stays. Office is alive behind it.

Transition to dashboard (47.5-48.0s):

  • Closing message fades out: opacity 1 > 0, 300ms
  • The isometric office is already fully visible underneath
  • Dashboard UI elements (HUD bar, chat bar, mode switcher) fade in: opacity 0 > 1, 400ms
  • Recap is done. User is in their dashboard. Seamless.

Controls

Skip Button

  • Position: fixed, bottom-right, 24px margin
  • Text: "Skip" in Space Grotesk 400, 13px, text-muted
  • Hover: text-secondary
  • Click: immediately fade to dashboard (all animations cancel, 300ms crossfade)
  • Keyboard: Escape key also skips

Watch Again

  • Available in HUD drawer (settings area) after the recap has been viewed
  • "Watch weekly recap" button
  • Replays the exact same animation with current data

Replay on Demand

  • Settings > Weekly Recap section
  • "Watch this week's recap" button
  • "Watch last week's recap" option (keeps one week of history)

Data Requirements

Bobby needs these from the API to render the recap:

{
  "week_start": "2026-03-10",
  "week_end": "2026-03-16",
  "agents": [
    {
      "slug": "bobby",
      "name": "Bobby",
      "color": "#3B82F6",
      "tasks_completed": 8,
      "top_task": "Ship /case-study page",
      "xp_earned": 120,
      "level": 7,
      "level_changed": false
    }
  ],
  "totals": {
    "tasks_completed": 23,
    "messages": 147,
    "mvp_agent": "bobby",
    "hours_saved": 18.5,
    "xp_earned": 340,
    "business_level": 5,
    "level_progress": 0.65
  },
  "streak": {
    "current": 14,
    "multiplier": 2.0
  },
  "priorities": [
    {
      "agent_slug": "bobby",
      "text": "Rebuild /v2 to audit standard"
    },
    {
      "agent_slug": "jacob",
      "text": "Send 20 CPA outreach emails"
    },
    {
      "agent_slug": "cleo",
      "text": "Crown v9 text overlays"
    }
  ],
  "comparison": {
    "tasks_delta": 12,
    "messages_delta": -5,
    "xp_delta": 40
  }
}

Responsive

Mobile Adjustments

Element Desktop Mobile
Title card text 16px 14px
Agent highlight zoom Neighborhood (1.6) Slightly less (1.3)
Speech bubble width 220px 180px
Stats grid 3x2 2x3
Stat card width 200px 140px
Stat numbers 28px 22px
Streak flame 48px 36px
Priority panel Right-aligned Full width bottom
Closing message 28px 22px
Skip button Bottom-right Bottom-center

Performance

  • Total animation: ~48 seconds max, shorter if fewer agents
  • Framer Motion orchestration: use stagger and delay props, not setTimeout chains
  • Isometric office: use the already-rendered canvas, don't re-initialize
  • Pre-compute all data before animation starts (no API calls during playback)
  • Assets: all sprites already loaded from dashboard. No additional loads.
  • Target: 60fps throughout. If dropping below, reduce particle count.

Low-End Device Fallback

If window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches:

  • Skip all animation. Show a static recap card instead:
    • Title: "Week of March 10-16"
    • Stats in a simple grid (no animation)
    • Priorities listed below
    • "Close" button
  • This respects accessibility preferences while still delivering the data.

Sharing (Future)

  • "Share recap" button generates a screenshot or short video
  • Screenshot: Playwright captures the stats roll-up frame
  • Video: client-side recording of the animation (MediaRecorder API)
  • Export formats: PNG (screenshot), MP4 (video, 720p)
  • Share destinations: download, copy link, social media

Not for C5 MVP. Capture the concept for C6.

The weekly recap is the "is this worth it?" answer delivered in 45 seconds. No spreadsheet. No report. Just your agents showing up, your numbers going up, and your week laid out. Monday mornings just became the best part of using Corner.
